def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    sep=next(c for c in set(sum(grid,[])) if any(all(x==c for x in row) for row in grid) and any(all(grid[i][j]==c for i in range(h)) for j in range(w)))
    rs=[i for i in range(h) if all(x==sep for x in grid[i])]

    rb=[-1]+rs+[h]; cb=[-1]+cs+[w]
    cells=[[(i,j) for i in range(a+1,b) for j in range(c+1,d)] for a,b in zip(rb,rb[1:]) for c,d in zip(cb,cb[1:])]
    from collections import Counter
    vals=Counter(grid[i][j] for cell in cells for i,j in cell if grid[i][j]!=sep)
    # Most frequent non-separator color is the ordinary output color; other color is the marker.
    base=vals.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker=next((x for x in vals if x!=base),None)
    out=[]
    for a,b in zip(rb,rb[1:]):

        for c,d in zip(cb,cb[1:]):
            n=sum(grid[i][j]==marker for i in range(a+1,b) for j in range(c+1,d)) if marker is not None else 0
            row.append(1 if n>=2 else base)
        out.append(row)
    return out
